segments.text: Right now your job data lives in six places. A spreadsheet, a shared inbox, a camera roll, a job book, an accounting package, and someone's memory.
A CRM is one record per job that all six of those things write into instead.
Client details, site photos, moisture readings, scope, quote, invoice. Entered once, on site, and never retyped.
The saving is not the software. It is the double handling you stop paying for. The re-keying, the chasing, the reconciling of two systems that disagree.
Every hour a technician spends retyping is an hour nobody bills. Every photo that never leaves a phone is a line item you cannot defend.
RestoreAssist is that single record, built for restoration work.
Start with one job. Run it end to end. Compare it to how you ran the last one.
